desc:
CAKE MIX: Bake a delicious, moist German chocolate cake dessert

QUICK AND EASY: Make a cake by just adding a few simple ingredients as directed and popping in the oven

ENDLESS OPTIONS: Add your own twist to these mixes by using as cupcake mix or trying tested and trusted Betty Crocker recipes

DELICIOUS & SPONGY: Enjoy the sweetness of this versatile baking mix and make it your own; Bake German chocolate cake mix for sweet celebrations and everyday moments

CONTAINS: 13.25 oz (Pack of 12)
features:
Features

Rich German Chocolate Flavor

Made with cocoa processed with alkali, this mix delivers a deep, smooth chocolate taste that’s true to traditional German chocolate cakes.

Super Moist Texture

Designed to produce a soft, fluffy, and tender crumb with every bake.

Easy to Prepare

Just add water, oil, and eggs—no complicated steps or equipment needed.

Versatile Baking Use

Perfect for cakes, cupcakes, layered desserts, and more.

Ideal Pairing with Coconut-Pecan Frosting

Complements the classic topping traditionally used with German chocolate cake.

Kosher Certified and Box Tops for Education Eligible

Aligns with kosher dietary preferences and supports school programs.

Clean, Familiar Ingredients

Contains enriched flour, sugar, corn syrup, cocoa, and leavening agents—free from artificial flavors.

Convenient Size

A 13.25 oz box yields a full-size cake or up to 24 cupcakes.

Benefits

Bakery-Quality Results at Home

Achieve rich, chocolatey flavor and perfect moisture without baking expertise.

Perfect for Special Occasions

Elegant enough for birthdays, holidays, or celebrations—yet simple enough for everyday indulgence.

Customizable & Creative

Great base for bakers to add nuts, chocolate chips, or swirl-in flavors.

Dependable Every Time

Trusted for its consistent texture, rise, and flavor in every batch.

Family Favorite Flavor

Loved by kids and adults alike thanks to its sweet chocolate richness and soft texture.

Saves Time Without Compromising Taste

Quick to mix and bake—ideal for busy households or last-minute dessert needs.

Budget-Friendly Indulgence

Offers great value for the quality, making it a smart pick for home bakers.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Corn Syrup, Leavening (baking soda, monocalcium phosphate, sodium aluminum phosphate), Cocoa Processed with Alkali. Contains 2% or less of: Modified Corn Starch, Palm Oil, Corn Starch, Propylene Glycol Mono and Diesters, Monoglycerides, Salt, Dicalcium Phosphate, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Xanthan Gum, Cellulose Gum, Artificial Flavor.
